outline.rationale: The user is a technically fluent SWE (has shipped ML/LLM features) still deciding whether AIPM fits. So I skip all AI/ML fundamentals and job-hunt/interview/resume tactics entirely, per the confirmed understanding. The outline is a fit-and-gap exploration. Node 1 grounds them in the real day-to-day. Node 2 isolates what's distinctive about *AI* PM vs. generic PM, relevant given their technical background. Nodes 3 and 4 form the core transfer/gap analysis (SWE strengths that carry over vs. product muscles to build), kept MECE by separating existing assets from new skills. Node 5 pulls out stakeholder/communication as its own bucket since it's a major PM domain distinct from discovery/prioritization. Node 6 addresses the specifically-AI craft of eval and ambiguity, leveraging their technical depth. Nodes 7 and 8 directly serve the 'still exploring fit' stance — honest self-assessment signals and cheap ways to test-drive the role before committing. Interview prep is intentionally excluded as premature.
